goal: Capture genuinely pre-race current-state data with machine-verifiable announcement/acquisition times so Race-time Snapshot Gate V2 can be evaluated without using post-race JVD current-state fields.

platform.api: JRA-VAN Data Lab JV-Link ActiveX COM
platform.runtime: x86 process required unless local JV-Link installation proves otherwise

dataspecs.purpose: 速報開催情報 一括

POLLING_BASELINE.method: At a fixed cadence on race days, call JVRTOpen for 0B11 and 0B14 using the current date key; read all available records; preserve each raw response snapshot.
POLLING_BASELINE.reason: Simple, auditable baseline. One-minute polling is sufficient for proving availability before EARLY/LATE snapshots while avoiding excessive local complexity.

EVENT_PUSH_OPTIONAL.method: Use JVWatchEvent to receive jockey/weather/course/avoid/time/weight events, then retrieve/persist the referenced record immediately.
EVENT_PUSH_OPTIONAL.promotion_condition: Enable only after the polling baseline has a successful real capture and local stability test.

storage.rule: Never overwrite raw captures. Each poll/event gets a unique capture_id and raw file SHA-256 before parsing.

state_rules: Maintain an append-only raw event/capture ledger separately from a derived current-state snapshot.

For 0B14, a later poll may withdraw/change prior information; the current-state snapshot must be rebuilt from the newest official poll response and must not silently preserve withdrawn change-state as current truth.
Never edit prior raw captures; derived current state may be regenerated but must cite the exact raw capture SHA used.
At EARLY/LATE prediction time, freeze a provenance snapshot and do not backfill it later.
time_rules: source_announcement_time_jst comes from the official realtime record's 発表月日時分 when present.
local_capture_time_jst is recorded immediately on receipt using an offset-aware JST timestamp.

For a feature to pass Gate V2, source_announcement_time_jst (or a stricter approved source time) must be <= prediction_snapshot_time_jst and the raw capture containing it must have been acquired no later than that snapshot.
If official source time is absent/ambiguous for a feature, do not infer it from final-state JVD; classify the feature as unavailable for that snapshot.

prediction_snapshot_freeze.EARLY: existing prediction snapshot time for that race
prediction_snapshot_freeze.LATE: existing prediction snapshot time for that race

fail_closed_conditions: capture time occurs after prediction snapshot
duplicate contradictory feature values cannot be deterministically ordered by official source time
system clock is not offset-aware JST or cannot be validated

clock_audit.per_capture: record offset-aware JST and UTC equivalents
clock_audit.rule: Clock-audit failure blocks Gate PASS for the affected capture.

first_real_capture_scope.purpose: plumbing/timing validation only; not model performance evaluation

promotion_sequence: only if PASS: create a new DEV-family prereg
hash prereg and commit external anchor before execution
explicit_non_goals: No DEV v6 before a real capture passes Gate V2
No retrospective laundering of old DEV periods using short-retention realtime feeds
No parameter/model sweep during data-plumbing validation
